done_when: A repo lists tests every change must run in forge.toml's always_test, close runs them locally beside the picked tests, and this repo lists its rules, every-refusal and view-contract tests

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
A repo whose test command is `pytest tests/unit` can list `tests/contracts/test_rules.py` in `always_test`. The file-existence check passes, but close never adds that file to pytest's command, and the collection hook verifies only node IDs. If a picked unit test passes, close succeeds without running the listed file. The named proof uses `pytest tests`, so it does not cover this common layout.
findings.title: Close skips listed test files outside pytest's collection roots

why: Close picks local tests by imports and mentions, so cross-cutting tests such as the rules and every-refusal checks fail only in CI, a round later
